prompt: Create an ultra-realistic forced-perspective optical illusion portrait in a clean minimalist studio with a seamless warm light-gray background. Show a beautiful young woman with long dark brown hair walking confidently toward the right, looking slightly to her left with a calm expression, holding a transparent plastic cup of iced coffee in one hand. She wears an oversized light gray bomber jacket layered over a dark charcoal hoodie, very baggy light-wash denim cargo jeans, and gray-and-white sneakers. Use forced perspective so the denim fabric of one pant leg stretches dramatically backward, as if being pulled. Behind her, include exactly 1 tiny chibi-style mini version of the same woman, angry and determined, gripping the stretched pant leg with both hands and leaning back while pulling; the chibi has long brown hair, an exaggerated frowning face, a small gray jacket, dark hoodie, baggy jeans, and sneakers. Add exactly 7 simple black hand-drawn manga doodle accents around the figures: 2 sparkle clusters near the main woman, 1 sweat/concern mark near her head, 2 puffs of steam near the chibi, 1 set of pull-motion lines near the stretched pants, and 1 curved foot-motion mark near the front shoe. The image should blend photorealistic fashion photography for the main woman with a polished cartoon chibi character, sharp full-body composition, soft studio lighting, subtle floor shadow, editorial realism, no text, no watermark, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.
